title: Chains Module Overview
summary: This module provides a comprehensive set of 'Chain' implementations, which are structured sequences of calls to components like language models, retrievers, and other chains. It includes functionalities for conversational AI, document processing, structured output extraction, routing, and specialized tasks like moderation and browser automation.

nodes.label: Base Chain Abstraction
nodes.title: Base Chain Abstraction
nodes.description: Abstract base class for creating structured sequences of calls to components, providing a unified interface for execution, state management (memory), and observability (callbacks).

nodes.label: Constitutional AI Chain
nodes.title: Constitutional AI Chain
nodes.description: Applies constitutional principles to refine LLM responses through iterative critique and revision, using an initial LLMChain for response generation and subsequent LLMChains for critique and revision.

nodes.label: Conversational Retrieval Chain
nodes.title: Conversational Retrieval Chain
nodes.description: Facilitates conversational Q&A over retrieved documents by reformulating user questions based on chat history, retrieving relevant documents, and then using an LLM to answer.

nodes.label: Chat Vector DB Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.title: Chat Vector DB Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.description: A deprecated chain for conversational interaction with a vector database, performing similarity search to retrieve documents and using an LLM for Q&A.

nodes.label: Generate Few-Shot Example
nodes.title: Generate Few-Shot Example
nodes.description: Generates a new example based on a list of existing examples and a prompt template, leveraging an LLM for few-shot prompting.

nodes.label: FLARE Chain (Active RAG)
nodes.title: FLARE Chain (Active RAG)
nodes.description: Implements the FLARE (Forward-Looking Active Retrieval) approach for RAG, iteratively generating responses, identifying low-confidence spans, generating questions, retrieving documents, and refining the response.

nodes.label: Create History-Aware Retriever
nodes.title: Create History-Aware Retriever
nodes.description: Creates a runnable that generates a standalone question from chat history and a new query, then uses a retriever to fetch relevant documents. If no chat history, it passes the query directly.

nodes.label: LLM Summarization Checker Chain
nodes.title: LLM Summarization Checker Chain
nodes.description: Performs question-answering with self-verification, iteratively generating a summary, creating assertions, checking them, and revising the summary until assertions are met or max checks are reached.

nodes.label: Map-Reduce Chain
nodes.title: Map-Reduce Chain
nodes.description: Processes large texts by splitting them into chunks, applying a 'map' operation (e.g., summarization) to each chunk, and then combining the results with a 'reduce' operation.

nodes.label: OpenAI Moderation Chain
nodes.title: OpenAI Moderation Chain
nodes.description: Passes input text through OpenAI's moderation endpoint to check for content policy violations, configurable to raise an error or return a warning message.

nodes.label: NatBot Chain (Browser Automation)
nodes.title: NatBot Chain (Browser Automation)
nodes.description: An LLM-driven chain for browser automation, allowing the LLM to generate commands to interact with web pages based on an objective.

nodes.label: Web Crawler (Playwright)
nodes.title: Web Crawler (Playwright)
nodes.description: A web crawler utility that uses Playwright to navigate web pages, scroll, click, type, and extract visible elements, designed for browser automation chains.

nodes.label: Create Structured Output Chain (Legacy)
nodes.title: Create Structured Output Chain (Legacy)
nodes.description: [Legacy] Creates an LLMChain that uses OpenAI's function-calling API to extract structured output based on a given schema (dict or Pydantic model).

nodes.label: Create Citation Fuzzy Match Chain
nodes.title: Create Citation Fuzzy Match Chain
nodes.description: Creates an LLMChain designed to answer questions with citations, ensuring the answer uses exact words from the provided context.

nodes.label: Create Citation Fuzzy Match Runnable
nodes.title: Create Citation Fuzzy Match Runnable
nodes.description: Creates a runnable that answers questions with citations, leveraging LLM's bind_tools for structured output.

nodes.label: Create Extraction Chain
nodes.title: Create Extraction Chain
nodes.description: Creates an LLMChain that extracts information from text based on a provided JSON schema, using OpenAI function calling.

nodes.label: Create Pydantic Extraction Chain
nodes.title: Create Pydantic Extraction Chain
nodes.description: Creates an LLMChain that extracts information from text based on a provided Pydantic schema, using OpenAI function calling.

nodes.label: Get OpenAPI Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.title: Get OpenAPI Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.description: [Deprecated] Creates a SequentialChain for querying an API defined by an OpenAPI specification, using an LLM to generate API calls and a request chain to execute them.

nodes.label: Default API Call Function
nodes.title: Default API Call Function
nodes.description: A utility function to make HTTP requests based on parsed OpenAPI function calls, handling method, URL, parameters, and headers.

nodes.label: Create QA with Sources Chain
nodes.title: Create QA with Sources Chain
nodes.description: Creates a question-answering chain that returns an answer along with its sources, leveraging structured output.

nodes.label: Create Tagging Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.title: Create Tagging Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.description: [Deprecated] Creates an LLMChain that extracts and tags information from text based on a provided JSON schema, using OpenAI function calling.

nodes.label: Create Pydantic Tagging Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.title: Create Pydantic Tagging Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.description: [Deprecated] Creates an LLMChain that extracts and tags information from text based on a provided Pydantic schema, using OpenAI function calling.

nodes.label: Create OpenAI Tools Pydantic Extraction Chain
nodes.title: Create OpenAI Tools Pydantic Extraction Chain
nodes.description: Creates a runnable for extracting information from text based on one or more Pydantic schemas, leveraging OpenAI's tool-calling API.

nodes.label: QA Generation Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.title: QA Generation Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.description: [Deprecated] Generates question-answer pairs from a given text by splitting it into chunks and using an LLM to create Q&A for each chunk.

nodes.label: Load QA Document Processing Chain
nodes.title: Load QA Document Processing Chain
nodes.description: Generic loader for various document processing chains (Map Rerank, Stuff, Map Reduce, Refine) used in Question Answering contexts, handling both general QA and QA with sources.

nodes.label: Load Query Constructor Chain
nodes.title: Load Query Constructor Chain
nodes.description: Creates an LLMChain that constructs structured queries (e.g., for filtering documents) based on natural language input, document contents, and attribute information.

nodes.label: Structured Query Output Parser
nodes.title: Structured Query Output Parser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output into a StructuredQuery object, validating against allowed comparators, operators, and attributes for structured data querying.

nodes.label: Embedding Router Chain
nodes.title: Embedding Router Chain
nodes.description: Routes inputs to different downstream chains based on semantic similarity, using a vector store to find the most relevant destination based on the input's embedding.

nodes.label: LLM Router Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.title: LLM Router Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.description: [Deprecated] Routes inputs to different downstream chains using an LLM to decide the destination and prepare the next input.

nodes.label: Multi-Prompt Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.title: Multi-Prompt Chain (Deprecated)
nodes.description: [Deprecated] A multi-route chain that uses an LLMRouterChain to select among different prompts and their corresponding LLM chains.

nodes.label: Multi-Retrieval QA Chain
nodes.title: Multi-Retrieval QA Chain
nodes.description: A multi-route chain that uses an LLMRouterChain to select among different retrieval QA chains, each potentially using a different retriever or prompt.

nodes.label: Create Structured Output Runnable
nodes.title: Create Structured Output Runnable
nodes.description: Creates a runnable for extracting structured outputs from an LLM, supporting various OpenAI modes (functions, tools, JSON response format) and Pydantic schemas.

nodes.label: Load Summarization Chain
nodes.title: Load Summarization Chain
nodes.description: Generic loader for various summarization chains (Stuff, Map Reduce, Refine), configuring them with LLMs and prompts for document summarization.

nodes.label: Load Generic Chain
nodes.title: Load Generic Chain
nodes.description: Utility functions for loading various chain types (LLM, LLM Checker, LLM Math, QA with Sources, API, Hypothetical Document Embedder, Stuff Documents, Refine Documents, Map Reduce Documents, Vector DB QA, Retrieval QA, Vector DB QA with Sources, Retrieval QA with Sources, Map Rerank Documents, LLM Requests, Graph Cypher QA) from configuration dictionaries.

nodes.label: Stuff Documents Chain
nodes.title: Stuff Documents Chain

nodes.label: Vector Store

nodes.label: Runnable
